subject: Request to confirm eligible downtime window and credit apportionment
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina.park@fintrack.co>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinTrack Support <support@fintrack.co>
Date: Wed, 22 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinTrack – spike and 503s during peak card processing window

Hi Vivek,

We observed a ~12 minute window of widespread 503s on our checkout API between 02:35–02:47 UTC yesterday morning (local peak at 02:40). This caused ~8% failed transactions for that minute and has material revenue impact. Our SRE flagged this as an availability incident and asked us to open an SLA claim.

Can you confirm whether this maps to any Redwood serving outage or degraded host pool behavior on your side and whether it would be eligible for a pro‑rata credit under section 4.2 of our SLA?

I've attached a short CSV with our observed failure timestamps and sample request IDs (fintrack_incident_summary.csv).

Thanks,
Lina Park
Head of Payments, FinTrack
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@fintrack.co>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Oct 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FinTrack – spike and 503s during peak card processing window

Hi Lina — thanks for the heads up and for the CSV. I'm pulling preliminary telemetry now.

Quick notes:
- We see elevated 503s from 02:36:12–02:47:05 UTC on the US‑west tenant for FinTrack.
- There was an autoscaler jitter event in the host pool; some nodes rejoined while client sessions were being routed.

I copied Grace (support lead) and Karthik (inference reliability) to confirm eligibility and to pull the full trace bundle. If eligible, we'll calculate a pro‑rata credit consistent with your contract (section 4.2) and share the post‑incident evidence bundle.

Requested from you: could you confirm a small sample of affected request IDs from the CSV that you want prioritized in the trace pull?

Attachments: fintrack_incident_summary.csv (1KB, csv)

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Oct 2025 13:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FinTrack – spike and 503s during peak card processing window

Vivek / Grace — tagging with the quick tech summary for the bundle pull and eligibility check.

Findings so far (high level):
- Root cause: transient autoscaler decision loop that caused a small subset (~6%) of the host pool to be marked unroutable while session affinity persisted. This led to a spike in request failures until routing stabilized.
- Impact window per infra traces: 02:36:08–02:47:12 UTC. Matches Lina's CSV sample.
- Severity classification: SLO impact to availability; per our SLA terms, if the incident is service‑side and not attributable to customer misconfiguration, it is eligible for credit.

Action items for the customer email:
1) Confirm the request IDs Lina wants prioritized for evidence (we need 3–5).
2) If eligible, I will produce a tokenized trace bundle + aggregated error-rate chart.

I'll assemble the redwood_trace_bundle_20251022.tar.gz and include the autoscaler logs and route table snapshots. Grace — once Vivek signals to send to FinTrack, please include the calculation and the suggested remediation language.

—Karthik
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@fintrack.co>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Oct 2025 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FinTrack – spike and 503s during peak card processing window

Hi Lina — thanks for confirming the sample IDs earlier today. We completed an internal review and can confirm the following: 

Summary and conclusion
- Downtime window: 2025‑10‑22T02:36:08Z through 2025‑10‑22T02:47:12Z (UTC).
- Root cause: autoscaler jitter caused a brief routing gap for a subset of your tenant's host pool; this was a service‑side event.
- Eligibility: Under section 4.2 of your SLA (availability SLO), this event meets the criteria for a pro‑rata credit.

Credit calculation (proposed)
- Observed impacted percentage at peak minute: ~8% failed transactions (customer observed).
- Using contractual formula (eligible downtime minutes / total billing minutes) gives a provisional credit of 0.06% of monthly invoice for the affected billing cycle.

Attached evidence and next steps
- Attached: redwood_trace_bundle_20251022.tar.gz (log bundle, token‑redacted traces, autoscaler logs) and the earlier CSV.
- We will open a formal credits request ticket and include the full trace bundle and error‑rate chart. Grace will follow up with proposed language for the credit memo and a Draft SLA exception confirmation.

Would you like us to proceed with the credit memo now, or would you prefer a brief call to walk through the timeline and the evidence? We can schedule a 30‑minute review tomorrow morning if that helps.

Apologies for the disruption — we understand this impacted a critical peak window for FinTrack. We're also proposing an autoscaler stability patch (rollout next week) to reduce the risk of recurrence; Karthik will coordinate the technical follow‑up.

Best regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
